description: Provision a Google Cloud Compute ComputeRouter via Config Connector. Fields mirror the compute.cnrm.cloud.google.com/v1beta1 ComputeRouter spec.

bgp.description: BGP information specific to this router.

advertiseMode.description: User-specified flag to indicate which mode to use for advertisement. Default value: "DEFAULT" Possible values: ["DEFAULT", "CUSTOM"].

advertisedGroups.description:
User-specified list of prefix groups to advertise in custom mode.
This field can only be populated if advertiseMode is CUSTOM and
is advertised to all peers of the router. These groups will be
advertised in addition to any specified prefixes. Leave this field
blank to advertise no custom groups.

This enum field has the one valid value: ALL_SUBNETS.

advertisedIpRanges.description: User-specified list of individual IP ranges to advertise in custom mode. This field can only be populated if advertiseMode is CUSTOM and is advertised to all peers of the router. These IP ranges will be advertised in addition to any specified groups. Leave this field blank to advertise no custom IP ranges.

description.description: User-specified description for the IP range.

range.description: The IP range to advertise. The value must be a CIDR-formatted string.

asn.description: Local BGP Autonomous System Number (ASN). Must be an RFC6996 private ASN, either 16-bit or 32-bit. The value will be fixed for this router resource. All VPN tunnels that link to this router will have the same local ASN.

keepaliveInterval.description:
The interval in seconds between BGP keepalive messages that are sent
to the peer. Hold time is three times the interval at which keepalive
messages are sent, and the hold time is the maximum number of seconds
allowed to elapse between successive keepalive messages that BGP
receives from a peer.

BGP will use the smaller of either the local hold time value or the
peer's hold time value as the hold time for the BGP connection
between the two peers. If set, this value must be between 20 and 60.
The default is 20.

description.description: An optional description of this resource.

encryptedInterconnectRouter.description: Immutable. Indicates if a router is dedicated for use with encrypted VLAN attachments (interconnectAttachments).

networkRef.description: A reference to the network to which this router belongs. Set exactly one of `external` (the resource's GCP URI or ID) or `name` (plus optional `namespace`) referencing another Config Connector resource in the cluster.

external.description: A reference to an externally managed ComputeNetwork resource. Should be in the format "projects/{{projectID}}/global/networks/{{networkID}}".

name.description: The name of a ComputeNetwork resource.

namespace.description: The namespace of a ComputeNetwork resource.

projectId.description: GCP project ID for this resource. Rendered as the cnrm.cloud.google.com/project-id annotation. Leave empty to inherit the project from the namespace (Config Connector falls back to the namespace's project-id annotation, then to the namespace name). Leave empty when this resource's spec already carries a projectRef.
projectId.title: GCP project ID

region.description: Immutable. Region where the router resides.

resourceID.description: Immutable. Optional. The name of the resource. Used for creation and acquisition. When unset, the value of `metadata.name` is used as the default.
